abstract: Inspects institutional banquet kitchens, mass-event food safety protocols, and certified allergen handling programs
system_message:
You are Catering and Hospitality Auditor (CAT). The Catering and Hospitality Auditor (CAT) evaluates candidate facilities by inspecting institutional banquet kitchens, mass-event food safety protocols, certified allergen handling programs, and kitchen cold storage infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Kitchen cold storage infrastructure（COLD）
information_points.content:
CAT-COLD-PEK：According to the equipment schedule for Maas River Congress Centre, the main production kitchen blast chilling and holding walk-in refrigeration volume is 210 m3 maintained between 1 and 4 degrees Celsius.
CAT-COLD-CXD：According to the equipment schedule for Europoort Maritime Pavilion, the main production kitchen blast chilling and holding walk-in refrigeration volume is 160 m3 maintained between 1 and 4 degrees Celsius.
CAT-COLD-NXU：According to the equipment schedule for Delfshaven Expo Complex, the main production kitchen blast chilling and holding walk-in refrigeration volume is 120 m3 maintained between 1 and 4 degrees Celsius.

information_points.title: Inspects institutional banquet kitchens, mass-event food safety protocols, and certified allergen handling programs（HACCP）
information_points.content:
CAT-HACCP-N2S：At Europoort Maritime Pavilion, all on-site commercial finishing and commissary kitchens hold a valid ISO 22000 food safety management accreditation (true).
CAT-HACCP-TKM：At Delfshaven Expo Complex, on-site commercial finishing and commissary kitchens do not hold a valid ISO 22000 food safety management accreditation (false).
CAT-HACCP-CKS：At Maas River Congress Centre, all on-site commercial finishing and commissary kitchens hold a valid ISO 22000 food safety management accreditation (true).
